name: range
useFor: Use under a numeric field when the value has a known span (Within 40 to 120 ac). Share one value between the field and the ruler, so typing moves the handle and dragging writes the field. Give it an aria-label.
constraints: A Range without a field or text showing the exact value
source: Figma "UI · Inputs" (442:107): Range 442:134 and Helper 442:137 under the Filled field
title: Range
description: A tick ruler for one value under a field: 1px Stone ticks 8px tall every 6px, a 1.5px Forest handle that snaps to the nearest tick, and 12px helper text in 80% Forest. The ticks rise like a ruler under a lens near the pointer and the handle.
